target_year_over_year_context.explanation:
Both disclosures describe the historical seasonality of net revenue, specifically that it is higher in the second half of the fiscal year due to wireless communications product seasonality driven by OEM mobile device launches. D080 states 'net revenue has typically been higher in the second half... primarily due to seasonality in our wireless communications products... due to launches of new mobile devices'. D091 states 'net revenue has typically been higher in the second half... primarily due to seasonality in our wireless communications products... due to launches of new mobile devices'.

Both disclosures discuss factors that may overshadow typical seasonality, such as macroeconomic effects and product transition timing. D080 notes 'typical seasonality... are overshadowed by other factors such as wider macroeconomic effects, the timing of significant product transitions'. D092 notes 'typical seasonality and industry cyclicality are overshadowed by other factors such as wider macroeconomic effects, the timing of customer deployments, significant product transitions'.

comparisons.peer_summary: AMD's operating results vary seasonally, with historically higher net revenue in the second half of the year compared to the first half, although these trends may be impacted by market conditions and product transitions.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and AMD disclose that their net revenue historically peaks in the second half of the fiscal year, driven by specific product cycles (wireless communications for AVGO; general operating results for AMD). However, both companies emphasize that these historical seasonal trends are not guaranteed and can be disrupted by external factors; AVGO cites macroeconomic effects and customer deployment timing, while AMD cites market conditions and product transitions.

We have a diversified business portfolio and we believe that our overall revenue is less susceptible to seasonal variations as a result of this diversification.
Our operating results tend to vary seasonally.

Historically, our net revenue has been generally higher in the second half of the year than in the first half of the year, although market conditions and product transitions could impact these trends.
